# Gender Predictor
> Free baby gender prediction tool combining 9 methods: Chinese calendar, Ramzi theory, nub theory, heart rate, old wives tales, baking soda test, skull theory, ring test, and gut feeling.

## Tool
- /: Main prediction tool with all 9 methods combined, plus baby name finder and countdown timer. Works for conceptions in 2026 and 2027 (the Chinese gender chart itself never changes year to year).

## Methods
- /chinese-gender-chart/: Chinese gender calendar predictor with full calendar table
- /baking-soda-gender-test/: Baking soda gender test guide and interactive predictor
- /ring-gender-test/: Wedding ring pendulum test guide
- /baby-gender-prediction-quiz/: 15-question old wives tales quiz
- /boy-or-girl-quiz/: Quick boy or girl prediction quiz

## Comparisons
